g1.label: 1. Companies must obtain:
g1.why: The text says companies must obtain explicit consent before collecting data.

g2.label: 2. Time to report a data breach?
g2.why: The text says organisations have to report breaches within 72 hours.

g3.label: 3. What is NOT allowed under GDPR?
g3.why: The text says companies must not sell data without permission.

g1.label: 1. Companies ___ collect data without consent
g1.why: ‘Must not’ expresses a prohibition — collecting data without consent is forbidden.

g2.label: 2. Organizations ___ implement security measures
g2.why: ‘Must’ expresses a strong obligation to implement security measures.

g3.label: 3. Breach notifications ___ be sent within 72 hours
g3.why: ‘Must’ expresses the legal obligation to report within 72 hours.

g4.label: 4. Employees ___ receive training regularly
g4.why: ‘Should’ expresses a recommended good practice rather than a strict legal rule.
